dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: Something noteworthy... Well, the weather is noteworthily nice today. And the breeze sure is comfortable. The ocean looks beautiful from here, too.

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: Now THIS is art! If only I could show those old geezers back at the auction house...

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: Indeed! The composition is rough yet somehow exquisite, the form chaotic but strangely ordered — Aino has managed to redefine the entire meaning of scrap using a language purely her own!

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the world were left in the hands of people like us! More's the pity, it's always the uncultured philistines who rise to the top...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's a little too... avant-garde?

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: ...I see. I guess Aino's work is not designed to please the masses. Just as I have no desire to please some passing stranger — goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not sure I'd want the responsibility...

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: I completely understand! Simply explaining beauty to those tasteless yahoos is exhausting, let alone doing anything else.

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: If those trend-chasing sheeple were actually to hitch themselves to the bandwagon of Aino's brilliance... Ugh, I shudder to think! True art is best left to people like us to enjoy in peace.
